svg.text: Gowin GW1NR-LV9 · single 81 MHz clock domain (rPLL 27 → 81 MHz) · signed two’s complement throughout · I and Q paths identical (one shown)
SFDR set by 10-bit phase / 16-bit amplitude LUT
48b integrators MATCH the 48b combs (modulo-2⁴⁸ wrap cancels exactly); worst case needs 41b
E1 and E2 are split over two clocks for timing (Fmax); costs 1 clock of the 432 available
FIR decimate-by-6 (252 taps, one serial MAC per channel)
MAC runs 257 of every 2592 clocks · output 31.25 kHz
257 clocks per output = 252 taps + 1 BRAM read + 3 MAC + 1 round; unused taps read the zero pad, so the accumulator adds every clock
Overall gain ×4 × 4.806 × 1.665 = ×32.0 ⇒ full-scale ADC sine (±2048 in the 12-bit slot) → |IQ| = 32768 at the output; digital clipping coincides with ADC clipping
nb = bus width in bits · label above a REG = Verilog name
